title: astragalus lusitanicus
intro: Astragalus lusitanicus, commonly known as Lusitanian milk-vetch, is a perennial plant species in the pea family (Fabaceae) native to Portugal and Spain. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to provide various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects, which help to boost the immune system and reduce the risk of infections. The therapeutic actions of Astragalus lusitanicus are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antibacterial activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been shown to have potential in the prevention and treatment of various diseases, including cardiovascular diseases, diabetes, and cancer.
